purpose: Verify creation of a new file with mandatory comment and optional attachment
preconditions: User is logged in as an Institute Employee with an assigned role.
action_or_input: Initiate file creation, enter a comment, attach a file, and save as draft.
expected_result: File is created in 'Draft' state with the comment and attachment associated.

purpose: Verify that file creation fails without a mandatory comment
preconditions: User is logged in as an Institute Employee with an assigned role.
action_or_input: Initiate file creation, leave comment field empty, attempt to save.
expected_result: System prevents saving and displays a validation error for missing comment.

purpose: Verify editing a saved draft file
preconditions: A draft file exists created by the logged-in user.
action_or_input: Open the draft file, modify the comment or add an attachment, and save.
expected_result: Draft file is updated with the new content.

purpose: Verify discarding a draft file
preconditions: A draft file exists created by the logged-in user.
action_or_input: Select the draft file and choose the discard option.
expected_result: The draft file is removed from the user's list and no longer accessible.

purpose: Verify submitting a file to another employee with mandatory comment and optional attachment
preconditions: A valid file (draft or new) exists. Another Institute Employee exists in the system.
action_or_input: Submit the file to another employee, add a mandatory movement comment, optionally add an attachment.
expected_result: File status changes to 'Circulated'. File appears in recipient's Inbox. Movement is recorded.

purpose: Verify that forwarding/returning a file fails without a mandatory comment
preconditions: User has a received file in their Inbox.
action_or_input: Attempt to forward or return the file without adding a comment.
expected_result: System prevents the action and displays a validation error.

purpose: Verify forwarding a received file to a third party
preconditions: User has a received file in their Inbox. A third Institute Employee exists.
action_or_input: Open the file from Inbox, forward it to a third employee with a mandatory comment.
expected_result: File moves to the third employee's Inbox. Original sender is notified if applicable. History updated.

purpose: Verify returning a received file to the sender
preconditions: User has a received file in their Inbox.
action_or_input: Open the file from Inbox, select 'Return to Sender', add a mandatory comment.
expected_result: File returns to the previous sender's Inbox. Movement history records the return.

purpose: Verify Inbox and Outbox visibility
preconditions: User has sent at least one file and received at least one file.
action_or_input: Navigate to Inbox and Outbox views.
expected_result: Inbox lists received files. Outbox lists sent files.

purpose: Verify opening files from Inbox and Outbox
preconditions: User has files in Inbox and Outbox.
action_or_input: Click on a file in Inbox and a file in Outbox.
expected_result: File details, comments, and attachments are displayed correctly for both.

source_id: AFR-FTS-035, AFR-FTS-036, AFR-FTS-037, AFR-FTS-038, AFR-FTS-039, AFR-FTS-040, AFR-FTS-041
purpose: Verify complete chronological tracking history visibility
preconditions: A file has undergone multiple movements (creation, forward, return).
action_or_input: View the tracking history of the file as an associated user.
expected_result: History displays all events chronologically with sender, receiver, timestamp, comments, and attachments.

purpose: Verify only file owner can archive a file
preconditions: File is in 'Circulated' state. User A is the owner. User B is a non-owner associated user.
action_or_input: User B attempts to archive the file. User A attempts to archive the file.
expected_result: User B's action is blocked/denied. User A's action succeeds, changing file state to 'Archived'.

purpose: Verify archived file is readable but not modifiable or forwardable
preconditions: A file is in 'Archived' state.
action_or_input: Attempt to edit the file. Attempt to forward the file. View the file.
expected_result: File is viewable. Edit and Forward actions are disabled or blocked.

purpose: Verify role switching preserves file ownership and audit identity
preconditions: User has two roles (Role A and Role B). User created a file while acting as Role A.
action_or_input: Switch context to Role B. Check ownership of the previously created file.
expected_result: File remains owned by the user (associated with Role A context originally). Audit log shows original creator identity.

purpose: Verify System Admin cannot perform operational file actions
preconditions: User is logged in as System Admin.
action_or_input: Attempt to create a file, forward a file, or archive a file.
expected_result: Actions are blocked or options are not available to System Admin.

purpose: Verify notifications are triggered for file events
preconditions: Notification mechanism is mocked/integrated. Users are subscribed.
action_or_input: Receive a file, forward a file, return a file, archive a file.
expected_result: Corresponding notifications are generated and handed to Fusion notification mechanism for each event.

source_id: AFR-FTS-054, AFR-FTS-055, AFR-FTS-056, AFR-FTS-057, AFR-FTS-058, AFR-FTS-059
purpose: Verify audit logs are maintained for all key actions
preconditions: Audit logging is enabled.
action_or_input: Perform file creation, add comment, add attachment, forward, return, and archive.
expected_result: Audit log contains entries for each action with timestamps and user details.

purpose: Verify FTS APIs are exposed for other modules
preconditions: API endpoints are deployed. Authenticated token from another module is available.
action_or_input: Invoke API for workflow status, approval chain check, or request tracking.
expected_result: API responds with correct data within RBAC limits.

purpose: Verify RBAC and Audit controls apply to API integrations
preconditions: API endpoint exists.
action_or_input: Invoke API with unauthorized token/role. Invoke API and check audit log.
expected_result: Unauthorized access is denied. Action is recorded in audit log.

purpose: Verify circulated files cannot be deleted
preconditions: File is in 'Circulated' state.
action_or_input: Attempt to delete the file via UI or API.
expected_result: Deletion is blocked. File remains in system.
